title: I took my colored pencil sketches of gross little characters into 3D, then built a world for them to live in, just wetter
author: adonismaximus
selftext:
I'm an illustrator. Hairy Popsicles started as a pile of colored pencil drawings: heads on sticks, a slimy frog thing, a guy made of bricks, all a little gross.

A few weeks ago I turned the drawings into a small 2D game. This time I wanted to see them with weight and skin, so I ran the sketches through Kling 3.0 to get 3D versions, and built a multiplayer world around them with Claude Code. I then made some whimsical background music with Suno. 

It's a farming game where the ground is skin and the crops are my characters. Plant a seed, something rises out of a hole, and it ripens into one of 25 of them. Collect them, play as any one, pop The Boil with whoever's online.

I was pleasantly surprised by how much of the original artwork carried over. The proportions, the weird details, the drips. They're still mine, just wetter.

Free in your phone browser (also plays on desktop): [https://hairypopsicles.com/the-mmo/](https://hairypopsicles.com/the-mmo/) just jump right in. No login, signup, totally free. just want people to get a glimpse into the world! 

Work in progress but happy to talk about the process.
